- The pool sits 361 records (34%) above the 700 ceiling in the protocol
- Decision for the last two slides: screen all 1,061 records, or trim the pool first.

G2 (Wed 21 Oct) has no new date. G3 is Fri 30 Oct (60% of N coded). Draft to Sensei Fri 20 Nov.

Sources: search-walkthrough Now table and Dedupe, then chaining (19 Oct).
:::

## Stream A froze at v2 in Scopus and v4 in Web of Science

::: {.table-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Stream A search versions"}
| Iter   | Keywords                                                                 | Results | Decision | Reason                                                                                                        |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| v0     | social-interaction terms AND choice-model terms AND network terms         | 188     | revise   | Recall on the 8 dev papers 1/8; the choice-model block is the bottleneck                                      |
| v1     | add Manski terms, social effect\*, identification near effect\*           | 485     | revise   | Noise 8/30: social effect\* matched the index term "Economic and social effects" in 175 of 297 new records    |
| v2     | social effect* limited to title, abstract, author keywords; both spellings of neighborhood | 315 | frozen | Precision 47/50, noise 12/30                                                                                  |
| WoS&nbsp;v2 | v2 string, topic search                                                   | 316     | revise   | Merged pool of 1,594 records exceeded the ceiling                                                             |
| WoS&nbsp;v3 | all three blocks in title, abstract, author keywords                      | 196     | revise   | Lost 40 on-topic records whose method word comes from Keywords Plus                                           |
| WoS&nbsp;v4 | Block 2 back on topic search                                              | 235     | frozen   | Returns 39 of the 40 lost records                                                                             |
:::

::: {.small}
WoS: Web of Science. Topic search (TS) covers title, abstract, author keywords and Keywords Plus, the words Web of Science takes from the titles of a paper's cited references. Precision: on-topic titles among the first 50 by relevance. Noise: on-topic records in 30 random new records.
:::

## Stream B froze at v2 after the pool fell from 3,611 to 253 records

::: {.table-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Stream B search versions"}
| Iter   | Keywords                                                             | Results | Decision      | Reason                                                                          |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| v0     | tie terms AND inference verbs AND mobility-data terms                 | 3,611   | revise        | Five times the ceiling; the bare word mobility is the only Block 3 term in 693 records |
| v1     | tie terms within 3 words of inference verbs; conference reviews removed | 426   | frozen&nbsp;8&nbsp;Oct  | Precision 41/50, noise 13/30; Eagle and Crandall return                         |
| v2     | social network counts when it sits in the title or author keywords                | 253     | frozen&nbsp;19&nbsp;Oct | Reopened because the merged pool reached 1,594; noise 15/30; Eagle and Crandall return |
| WoS&nbsp;v1 | v1 string, topic search                                               | 140     | revise        | Pool above the ceiling; Keywords Plus dropped                                   |
| WoS&nbsp;v2 | title, abstract, author keywords; social network in title or keywords | 77      | frozen        | Eagle found, Crandall missed (vocabulary gap in Block 2)                        |
:::

::: {.small}
Stream B has no dev or test set. Its check is that Eagle, Pentland and Lazer (2009) and Crandall et al. (2010) still return.
:::

## Stream C froze at v3 after two narrowing steps

::: {.table-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Stream C search versions"}
| Iter   | Keywords                                                                                       | Results | Decision      | Reason                                                                                              |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| v1     | actor-oriented model and relational-event phrases, network dynamics, coevolution near network terms, AND estimat* OR empirical* | 1,875 | revise | Precision 39/50; noise under 10/30: network dynamics was the only Block 1 term in 73% of records (brain connectivity, TCP queues) |
| v2     | network dynamics and coevolution phrases anchored by social OR tie* OR actor*                   | 663     | frozen&nbsp;13&nbsp;Oct | Precision 42/50, noise 17/30; all five benchmark papers return                                      |
| v3     | network dynamics and coevolution phrases limited to title or author keywords                       | 419     | frozen&nbsp;19&nbsp;Oct | Reopened for the pool ceiling; noise 22/30; all five benchmark papers return                        |
| WoS&nbsp;v2 | v2 string, topic search                                                                         | 491     | revise        | Pool above the ceiling                                                                              |
| WoS&nbsp;v3 | title, abstract, author keywords                                                                | 318     | frozen        | Benchmark papers return; two on-topic drops added by hand                                           |
:::

::: {.small}
The v3 cut costs an estimated 40 on-topic records, read from 30 sampled records, so the true loss could lie anywhere from 5 to over 100. Eight papers dropped by Scopus v3 and two by Web of Science v3 went into the pool by hand.
:::

## Option 1: screen the full pool, which takes 7 to 10 hours

- 231 of the 1,061 records carry a decision from earlier skim marks (120 include, 111 exclude)
- The other 830 records take 7 to 10 hours at 30 to 45 seconds each. The full 1,061 would take 9 to 13 hours
- The pool stays 361 records above the 700 ceiling, so the protocol records a deviation

| Day (proposal)  | Work                                                              |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Thu 22, Fri 23 Oct | Calibration pass 1 on 20 records, then screening, 3 hours a day |
| Mon 26 Oct      | Screening; calibration pass 2 after a day's gap                   |
| Tue 27 Oct      | Finish screening, which becomes the new G2                        |
| Wed 28 to Fri 30 Oct | Extraction. G3 (60% of N coded) has 3 days behind it, against 7 in the schedule. Under 60%, the stop rule cuts N |

::: {.small}
G2 was Wed 21 Oct and has no new date. The draft to Sensei stays on Fri 20 Nov.
:::

## Option 2: trim the pool first, which costs one to two search days

Reaching 700 means cutting 361 records. Candidate levers, none applied:

| Lever                                  | What it does                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| One more version per stream            | The cap allows A v3 in Scopus, B v3 and C v4. A without effect* in the peer proximity clause cuts about 14 records and no benchmark paper |
| Narrow C to the two named model families | Keep the actor-oriented and relational-event phrases and drop the rest. Loses De Nooy (2011), so it needs Sensei's agreement |
| Limit document types and publication stage | 45 pool records carry a mixed document type or a book chapter. Counts by type need a Scopus run  |
| Use more specific terms                | Phrases in place of bare words. The mobility phrase lever in Stream B lost Crandall (2010)         |
| Date window                            | Cannot reach 700: 96% of the pool dates from 2008 or later, and a cut would remove Butts (2008), Snijders (2010) and Eagle (2009) |

::: {.small}
Timeline estimate: the 19 Oct round (three string changes, both databases, Zotero pass, sheet rebuild) took one working day, so a second round takes one to two days before screening a smaller pool starts.
:::
